verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents user control over where data lives: Pass Items go in your own cloud or an encrypted external file, self-hosting is offered, and the browser extension keeps nothing permanently in browser memory or on third-party servers. Its Share feature adds retention controls through automatic link expiration and one-time access. missing for 10: explicit documentation of deleting vaults, tokens or backups (including cloud-synced copies), stated retention periods for any server-held data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You decide where to store your Items. You can store it in your own cloud or keep it as an encrypted file on an external drive.
